_comment: What the audit covers in THIS repository. Paths are relative to each project's root. Another repository is audited with `audit/run.sh --target <dir>`, which finds its contracts by itself (lib/scope.js). Excluded files are still compiled (others import them) but their findings are not reported; each exclusion says why.

exclude.contracts/VulnerableVault.sol: deliberately vulnerable target of the testnet bug-bounty demo (see its header); never holds value
exclude.contracts/MockMailbox.sol: TEST ONLY stand-in for a Hyperlane Mailbox (see its header)
exclude.contracts/TestStable.sol: worthless testnet faucet stablecoin (see its header)

exclude.contracts/TestToken.sol: testnet-only token with an owner mint (see its header)

core._comment: Money-holding contracts: SMTChecker targets (fast tier: the first 4, deep tier: all) and mutation-testing targets (deep tier). Each entry: project/path.

invariants._comment: Invariant / property suites, written separately (one directory per project). The pipeline runs whatever is there: foundry.toml -> forge test (invariant_* and test*), halmos (check_* functions), echidna.yaml -> echidna, medusa.json -> medusa. A missing directory counts as notRun, never as passed.
